newsitem.title: SPAIN: France Telecom ponders cross shareholding.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom ponders cross shareholding.

text.p: France Telecom is considering a cross shareholding with ally Deutsche Telekom but not until after the current privatisation frenzy calms, the head of France Telecom in Spain told daily El Mundo.

"Once the current wave of privatisations is over we are thinking of a cross shareholding between France Telecom and Deutsche Telekom in the capital of each company," Teixido said in an interview published on Sunday.
State-owned France Telecom has a strategic alliance with Deutsche Telekom as part of the Global One multinational consortium with America's Sprint.
France Telecom also said both companies wanted to tackle the northern European market together but that each had different focuses in the rest of Europe.
"France Telecom's objective is to get a foothold in the south of Europe, that is Spain, Portugal and Italy. Our friends at Deutsch Telecom want a strong presence in eastern Europe," Teixido said.

The French government has said it plans to sell 49 percent of France Telecom with a first tranche of about 20 percent being sold in April. The first 25 percent tranche of Deutsche Telekom is due to be sold on Monday.
